name: What kind of due diligence is needed for off-market investments?

mainEntity.name: What kind of due diligence is needed for off-market investments?

acceptedAnswer.text: Due diligence for off-market investments is critical and generally similar to on-market purchases but may require more proactive investigation due to less public information. This includes reviewing financials, conducting property inspections, assessing market conditions, and verifying legal documentation. A practical tradeoff is that while you might get a better deal, you may need to invest more time and resources in verifying property details, as sellers might not have compiled extensive documentation as they would for a publicly listed property.
acceptedAnswer.description: Due diligence for off-market properties includes financials, inspections, and legal review, often requiring more proactive buyer effort.
